tested_on: Prometheus 3.15.1 scraping a real node_exporter on Debian 13, read through a running Netlens (plugin test, enable, sync with history, readings on the device, the diagnostic with no names or addresses), HTTPS certificate pinning against a local server, bearer and basic login, the job filter with hostile input
reviews.notes: Written and lab-tested on 2026-10-28 with the assistant Claude. Verified for the Linux path (node_exporter) against a real Prometheus. Not tested: windows_exporter (its answers in the tests follow its documentation; metric names changed between versions, the uptime query tries both), VictoriaMetrics, Mimir, Thanos, a store behind a reverse proxy with a path prefix, an authenticated store. Plain http is refused unless switched on.
